vBRIEFInfo.description: Auto-synthesized minimal plan for PAN-2158: bug(plan): pan plan --auto escalates to interactive on a PRD-defaulted decision, stalling a critical-path agent the flywheel can't unblock

plan.title: bug(plan): pan plan --auto escalates to interactive on a PRD-defaulted decision, stalling a critical-path agent the flywheel can't unblock
plan.author: overdeck/auto-start

narratives.Problem:
## Symptom

Observed RUN-33 (2026-06-29) on PAN-2157 (the merge-unblocker fix). `pan plan PAN-2157 --auto` ran the analysis, produced a strong recommendation, then **stopped and asked the operator** — the agent pane ends with literal text *"Which way do you want me to go?"* and sits idle ("Baked for 4m 11s", blank prompt). The critical-path producer is stalled indefinitely.

## Why this is wrong

1. **The decision was already defaulted in the PRD.** PAN-2157's body enumerated 3 options (gh/installation token; provision GitHub App; warn-only) and the agent itself strongly recommended option 2 (gh token) as the smallest change that satisfies AC-1. `pan plan --auto` is documented to *"run end-to-end without prompting; if it encounters a contradiction it can't resolve, escalate to interactive; record inferred choices in plan.autoDecisions[]"*. A documented set of options with a clear best choice is **not** an unresolvable contradiction — auto-mode should have picked option 2, recorded it in autoDecisions, and proceeded.
2. **The flywheel cannot unblock it.** `pan tell` is forbidden from the flywheel role, so a single unanswered planning question stalls a producer with no autonomous recovery path. Combined with the --no-resume boot (no overflow-respawn), the agent just sits there.

## Fix direction (do not patch from flywheel role)

- **Primary:** `--auto` must NOT escalate to interactive when the PRD/issue documents the options and a defensible default exists. Pick the recommended option, record it in `plan.autoDecisions[]` with rationale, and continue. Reserve interactive escalation for genuine contradictions (conflicting requirements with no documented resolution).
- **Secondary (defense-in-depth):** when an --auto agent does ask a question, the deacon stuck-detector / a sanctioned advance path should be able to deliver the recorded default (or a 'proceed with your recommendation' nudge) so an unanswered question can't indefinitely strand a critical-path agent.

## Acceptance

- AC-1: `pan plan <id> --auto` on an issue whose body lists options + a recommended default produces a vBRIEF without prompting, with the chosen option recorded in `plan.autoDecisions[]`.
- AC-2: A simulated agent question under --auto is auto-advanced (or never asked), not left idle.

Discovered while orchestrating PAN-2157. Filed by the Flywheel orchestrator (RUN-33).
